name: Carrion Defense Works Terrain Denial Foam Canister TDF-3
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Terrain Denial Foam Canister TDF-3
description: A throwable canister that deploys a rapid-expanding structural foam capable of blocking doorways, corridors, and openings in under 5 seconds. The foam expands to 50x its canister volume and hardens to the compressive strength of concrete within 10 seconds of deployment. A single canister can seal a standard doorway with a barrier that requires power tools to remove. The foam is non-toxic and fire-resistant, making it safe for enclosed space deployment. Carrion markets it for emergency barricading, breach denial, and perimeter hardening, but it has been adopted by everyone from home defenders to bank robbers for creating instant obstacles.

specifications.coverage: Seals standard doorway (2m x 0.9m) per canister

story_hooks: Every exit from a building was sealed with TDF-3 foam simultaneously — someone trapped 200 people inside and the foam barriers will take hours to cut through.
A street community is using TDF-3 to build permanent structures — the foam hardens into walls that are as strong as concrete, and they are constructing entire buildings from throw canisters.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact cylindrical canister resembling a high-pressure spray can, but with reinforced ribbed sidewalls and a wider base for stability. The top features a prominent two-stage trigger mechanism — primary arming switch and secondary deployment lever. Clean industrial design with aggressive angular lines.
physical_description.dimensions: 12 cm tall, 7 cm diameter — slightly larger than a standard aerosol spray can
physical_description.weight_description: 600 grams per unit — handheld, pocketable in reinforced cargo gear or tactical harnesses; light enough for repeated throws
physical_description.primary_material: Aluminum alloy canister body with internal pressure-resistant composite liner; rubberized grip panels
physical_description.finish: Matte textured powder coat with high-friction grip surface; slight industrial sheen on polished aluminum endcaps
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal gray body with safety-orange grip panels and warning stripe; neon yellow arming indicator dot near trigger
physical_description.interface_elements: Top-mounted dual-stage trigger (safety lock + deployment lever), pressure gauge window showing canister status (green/yellow/red), recessed fill valve on base, molded finger grooves along grip, printed deployment instructions in white sans-serif lettering
distinctive_features: Ribbed pressure-resistant sidewalls resembling industrial gas cylinders
Integrated rubber shock absorber around base impact zone
Translucent pressure gauge window with color-coded status indicator
Two-stage trigger with tactile safety engagement click
Embossed Carrion Defense Works logo — stylized vulture skull wreathed in concentric circles
Mandatory disposal notice stamp in small print
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CARRION DEFENSE WORKS etched into shoulder; TDF-3 model designation; GLMZ regulatory compliance stamps; manufacturing date code; batch number; pressure rating in PSI
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and sealed in retail state; worn grip panels and minor denting common after field use; pressure gauge window may cloud with age; arming indicator fades to dull orange after 2-3 years
